headline: 166 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Little Giant Fire in WA, threatening 7,010 structures.

active_threats.name: Little Giant
active_threats.narrative: The Little Giant Fire in Chelan County, WA has burned 163,119 acres and is 49% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **7,010 structures threatened**. 1,634 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 10 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (SE) is not currently aligned toward Leavenworth city, the nearest community of size, 30 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over OK: Oklahoma City city, Tulsa city, Norman city, Broken Arrow city, and Edmond city and 23 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2,3). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 31% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
